blocks.text: Several kinds of evidence support evolution. This section looks at evidence from biogeography, comparative anatomy and molecular biology.

items: Comparative anatomy: homologous, analogous and vestigial structures.
Molecular biology: similar DNA and proteins in related organisms.

blocks.prompt: Name the three lines of evidence for evolution in this section.
blocks.explanation: Biogeography, comparative anatomy and molecular biology.

items: Evidence: biogeography, comparative anatomy, molecular biology.
